toast_note: Toast Anthology column is the Anthology Events POS net sales for May; the Kamper's column is blank because the Kamper's May Sales Summary was not provided. Total is all Book Tower events (Le Suprême / HIROKI-SAN excluded). * Toast keys bar packages across Liquor / Wine / Beer and rings ceremony, deposit and valet lines as Misc. Guest Fees, so beverage and fees only reconcile as a pair ($165,997 vs $165,867). Bar Rotunda has no POS report to compare.
narrative: What was done. Tripleseat exposes no line items through its API, so every May event's invoice document was pulled and parsed. Each line follows the BEO's room header (KAMPER'S, Kampers Rooftop Lounge, Bar Rotunda, Conservatory), a line that names Kamper's or Bar Rotunda goes to that outlet regardless, and standalone rooftop and Rotunda events stay 100% with their outlet. Service charge and admin fee come from each invoice's BILLING block and follow each outlet's share of base. Sales tax and gratuity are excluded throughout. Le Suprême and HIROKI-SAN private dining rows are their own book and are excluded.

Anthology's May is $448,894 net, $368,527 before service charge and admin fee. Toast shows $434,578, $14,316 less (3.3%), and the gap is not evenly spread: 11 of 22 event days tie within $700. Toast runs under the BEO on five weddings, Pierson 5/30 (−$8,033), Buck 5/22 (−$3,044), Lowery 5/02 (−$2,740), Malewicz 5/23 (−$2,411) and Yarosh 5/31 (−$1,376), which means Kamper's rang more of those nights than the BEO labels; the Kamper's May Toast would confirm it. The Boston's Communion cancellation fee ($3,456) and five photo sessions never hit the POS on their dates. Running the other way, Toast is $7,415 above the BEO across Rachel's Network 5/04–06.

Kamper's takes more than 20% of a shared wedding. It carries the canapés, its $1,000/hour reception fee and the cocktail hour of the five-hour bar package. Across the eight May weddings that shared a room with Kamper's the share runs 20–23%, averaging 21.9%. Jacques & Kazoleas ran its cocktail hour at Bar Rotunda instead and splits 12% that way. Where the cocktail hour was booked as its own event (Lake, Malewicz, Yarosh) Kamper's share is carried in the standalone line instead.

BEO fixes at source. Lowery (5/02), Miller (5/29) and Pierson (5/30) bill a Kamper's cocktail hour but leave the canapé block unlabelled, the same omission Toast confirmed on Hannigan and Joseph; the cocktail-hour rule moves those canapés to Kamper's here, and Toast says Pierson's rooftop share was larger still. Roth Capital (5/12) and Buzz Solutions (5/13) carry "Corporate Events" as their area on the invoice although they ran on the rooftop and at Bar Rotunda. Rachel's Network Day 1 (5/04) lists Kampers Rooftop Bar among its rooms with no Kamper's lines; it stays with Anthology.
